newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian stocks mixed, Kras takes spotlight.
newsitem.headline: Croatian stocks mixed, Kras takes spotlight.

text.p: Croatian stocks were mixed in thin trade on Wednesday with confectioner Kras taking the spotlight.
* Nine of 20 active stocks fell, three rose and eight were flat.
* Turnover was halved at 3.0 million kuna and volume shrank to 5,770 units.
* Confectioner Kras was both the biggest gainer and the most actively traded stock, climbing five kuna to 410 kuna on volume of 1,117 shares.
* Biggest loser was Croatia Banka which dipped 10 kuna to 130 kuna 159 units changing hands.
